subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the workflow and security owners approve this exact refreshed set of third-party action commits for token, release, scanning, repository-automation, and Codex execution paths?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but accepting newly executed third-party code with secrets, publishing access, and security-scanning responsibilities is an ownership decision that ordinary CI cannot make.

options.title: Approve verified batch
options.body: Rebase, verify the upstream commits and Codex contract, then approve the exact head after all required checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, scanning, and Codex updates from lower-risk setup and repository-maintenance actions for smaller trust decisions.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Keep the existing immutable commits until owners can complete the required source and runtime-contract review.

recommendation.title: Approve verified batch
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify the upstream commits and Codex contract, then approve the exact head after all required checks pass.
